title: Character lab: every 3D character, and a country switcher
kaylee: Nothing changes in her game. In the lab you can now see all 119 3D characters (it showed 64) and narrow the cast to one country.

pictures.title: The country switcher
pictures.caption: All is the default and works the same as before. Picking a country filters the list, and ← → stay inside it (on the phone too)
